_provenance.note: Observations were recorded against the version above; re-verify against the current spec snapshot before relying on them.

notes: 53 schemas — biggest domain in the API. Mostly social-feed concerns (posts, comments, likes, mentions, polls, articles).

Two parallel post shapes: Post is the modern shape (with $refs to standalone schemas like ShareMetadata, MarketEventMetadata). DiscussionsPost is an older inline shape that duplicates the Market structure inline.
Two parallel discussion-list response shapes: DiscussionsResponse (older, inline paging/metadata) and FeedResponse (newer, with $refs to FeedPagingResponse / FeedMetadataResponse).

Many small integer-encoded enums: PostType (8 variants), MediaType (4), EditStatus (3), VideoSource (3), ParentType (4), ReasonType (7), EmotionType (1), ArticleRating (2), ArticleStatus (3), CopyType (2). All wire-encoded as their integer index.
Comment is recursive: CommentDataResponse.replies is Vec<CommentDataResponse>. Use Box<...> in Rust to break the cycle if modeling directly.
Reason field on Discussion (older) is described as 'can be a string or an object' — use #[serde(untagged)] enum if encountered.
Discussion.reason field has no schema — completely untyped per spec
RequestBase / CommentRequest / DiscussionCreateRequest all share owner+message+tags+mentions+attachments. Worth a Rust trait or shared struct.

_removed_stamps.reason: Removed at the v1.355.0 refresh: upstream deleted these standalone enum components and inlined them as `type: string` enums at each use site, so there is no schema left to stamp and the declared wire format is no longer the integer index. The matching int_or_string_enum! types remain in src/types/manual.rs, unreferenced, because they also accepted the integer form -- reattach them if live responses turn out to still send integers.
